item.title: DIGIMON ALYSION Tier List: Best Decks at Launch | November 2026
item.description:
Last updated: 26 November 2026. This DIGIMON ALYSION tier list ranks the 12 strongest decks at launch from S to B. Four decks share the top tier: Yellow WarGreymon, Blue Yukinamon, Green Nidhoggmon and Black Zephagamon.
The ranking reflects the card pool at launch: the four booster packs from BD-01 NEW EVOLUTION to BD-04 GREAT LEGEND, plus the starter and entry decks. It will change as new packs arrive and ranked play settles.
Yellow WarGreymon is a control deck that trades away its own security for a chain of attacks, and it can switch between attacking and defending depending on the board.
Blue Yukinamon is the aggressive pick. It strips the digivolution cards from under the opponent’s Digimon to weaken them, and Yukinamon wins battles by comparing how many digivolution cards each Digimon has, not their DP. The story gives players the basic version of this deck for free.
Green Nidhoggmon floods the board thanks to cost reduction and is the best answer to fast aggro starts. Black Zephagamon controls the game with a wall of Blockers and can still build a board of its own through Zephagamon.
Red Rubiusdramon deletes the opponent’s Digimon while checking security, and it has plenty of cards that check more than one security card at a time. Green HerakleKabuterimon uses the same cost reduction as Nidhoggmon but plays aggressively, suspending enemy Digimon and finishing them with Piercing.
Green Leomon manages memory with on-deletion and when-attacking effects and keeps widening its board by bringing Digimon back suspended. MetalGarurumon & Plutomon is the purple deck: it revives Digimon from the trash, and the two namesake cards let it play expensive Option cards for free.
Two decks are built around Omnimon, a card every player received for free from the pre-registration rewards. Blue Omnimon uses its draw power to reach BT1-084 Omnimon reliably and mixes bounce removal with repeated attacks, while Red Omnimon digivolves in a straight line and leans on security-check boosts and removal.

item.title: DIGIMON ALYSION Is Out on iOS and Android in 183 Regions With Four Booster Packs
item.description:
DIGIMON ALYSION is out. BANDAI launched its Digimon Card Game app for iOS and Android on November 25, free to play with in-app purchases, in 183 countries and regions.
The DIGIMON ALYSION launch brings four booster packs at once, a premium battle pass and every pre-registration reward, after the campaign closed above 450,000 pre-registrations.
The final list is far wider than the 49 countries and regions announced during pre-registration. It covers Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, Hong Kong and most of Southeast Asia, including Indonesia, the Philippines, Thailand, Malaysia and Singapore, plus the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom and most of Europe. A few countries only get one of the two stores. China, India, Brazil and Vietnam are not on the list. The full list is in the official regions notice.
Cards come from booster packs, and four are on sale from day one. Each mixes cards from the paper game with ALYSION-original cards, including the story’s Tamers and their partner Digimon:
Ready-made decks work differently: players buy a Deck Missions Unlock Key for 250 DigiGems and earn the deck by clearing its missions. There are six Starter Decks for beginners, from ST-01 GAIA RED to ST-06 VENOMOUS VIOLET, and nine Entry Decks built around a Digimon such as Gallantmon, Imperialdramon or Diaboromon.
The trailer for NEW EVOLUTION, the first pack made for the app, shows its cards in action.
Every pre-registration milestone was reached before the DIGIMON ALYSION launch, so all players get the full set by in-game mail, to be claimed within 30 days: 40 pack tickets (10 each for BD-01 to BD-04), Gemmon, MetalGarurumon, WarGreymon, Omnimon, an Alt-Art Agumon and an SEC Decryption Ticket, which guarantees a high-rarity SEC card.
Season 1 has a free track and two paid versions: the Premium Battle Pass for 750 DigiGems and the Premium Battle Pass + EXP Bonus for 1,700 DigiGems, which also skips 20 levels and adds an upgrade chip. Its rewards include Gemmon card sleeves, a Gemmon icon and an SEC Decryption Ticket, and buying it late still pays out every level already reached.
Matches follow the rules of the paper Digimon Card Game, with the app handling costs and effects, ranked and friendly matches online, and a story set inside the VR card game DIGIMON LIBERATOR. Full details are on the official launch notice.

item.title: Azur Promilia Tier List: Best Characters at Launch | November 2026
item.description:
Last updated: 26 November 2026. This Azur Promilia tier list ranks all 22 playable characters from S to D. At the top sits Tushan Xiaoyu, the limited 5★ from the launch banner, followed by an A tier of six characters that covers the best healers, buffers and attackers in the game.
Placements reflect the Japanese version at launch, the build that went live on November 26 in Japan. The English version has not launched yet, so this Azur Promilia tier list also shows the characters and the balance that English players will meet first.
Tushan Xiaoyu is a 5★ Wind and Light Assault attacker, and she is strong against single bosses and groups of enemies alike. While her bond state is active, her enhanced special charge fires Wind EX attacks over and over, her combo chains just by holding the button, and her ultimate puts her straight into that state.
She needs plenty of Wind and Light marks, which is why her two best partners are Maple and the Starborn, both in A tier. Her banner guarantees a 5★ within 90 pulls and every 5★ it gives is her, with no 50/50, as we covered in our Azur Promilia launch news.
Maple hands out Light marks and raises team attack and damage, which makes her Tushan Xiaoyu’s natural partner. Metsa is a 5★ Wood healer who also refills ultimate charge and fits into most teams. The two attackers are Shalle, a Water and Light 5★ whose javelin deals heavy burst damage after her skills, and Morwyn, a Lightning and Wind 5★ who chains follow-up attacks into Lightning EX hits.
Katalua shields the team and gets stronger while the shield holds, so she shines in fights where the party takes a lot of hits. Han Youyou boosts the whole team’s EX damage with fireworks, Lan Xiangzi places a coffin that keeps attacking and raises team damage even after she swaps out, and Rubina is a Fire and Lightning gunner whose critical rate climbs the longer she keeps shooting.
Most of the lower tiers are breakers, the characters built to empty enemy stance gauges: Cathbelle, Abby and Faridah are 5★ breakers that sit in D, alongside Nono. The best attackers already break stance quickly on their own, so a dedicated breaker gives up a slot that a buffer or healer fills better.
In C tier, Mitty is still worth building for Morwyn, because she supplies the Lightning marks Morwyn depends on. Pengpeng boosts Fire and Earth teams, Terara is a sturdy Fire attacker that heals herself, Peipei hits groups with Earth and Light charged attacks, and Luruka summons spirits that raise team critical rate.
Azur Promilia is the open-world RPG from Manjuu, the studio behind Azur Lane, published in Japan by Yostar on PC, Android and iOS. Players explore the Promilia continent with a party of three characters and the Kibo, creatures that fight alongside them and help on the farm. The version 1.0 trailer shows the launch cast and the regions of the continent.

item.title: Azur Promilia Is Out in Japan With a Tushan Xiaoyu Banner and 40+ Free Pulls
item.description:
Azur Promilia is now live in Japan. Yostar and developer Manjuu opened the servers on November 26 at 11:00 JST on PC (Windows), Android and iOS, with progress shared across all three. The game is free to play with in-game purchases.
The Azur Promilia launch opens with a limited banner for Tushan Xiaoyu, a playful fox spirit, a story event built around her, and a set of welcome rewards that adds up to more than 40 free character pulls for new players.
Players arrive on the Promilia continent as the Starborn foretold by prophecy and travel with a party of characters and the Kibo, the creatures they bond with. The Kibo fight alongside the party and also help back on the farm, where each player runs their own land and a dormitory that can be decorated and used to spend time with the cast.
The version 1.0 trailer released for the Azur Promilia launch shows the main cast, the Kibo and the regions of the continent.
Once the gacha unlocks through the story, the beginner banner opens. It sells 10 pulls for 8 pull items instead of 10, up to a total of 30 pulls, and a 5★ character is guaranteed within those 30.
The first limited character banner, Peach Blossom Pact, features Tushan Xiaoyu. A 5★ is guaranteed within 90 pulls, and every 5★ it gives is the featured character, so there is no 50/50 to lose. Running alongside it is an Anima banner with Hana no Mai, a 5★ Anima themed on Tushan Xiaoyu, guaranteed within 80 pulls.
Pity on both banners carries over to the next limited banner of the same type. Both run until December 17 at 04:59 JST.
Tushan Xiaoyu also gets the first story event, which runs until January 5, 2027 at 04:59 JST. Players raise four of her stats through training and choices to reach one of five endings. The event rewards include 600 premium currency, 5 pull items, an event-only Anima and upgrade materials, plus an event shop.
The shop sells a limited bunny outfit for Tushan Xiaoyu and her own dorm set, both until January 5. Two more character outfits, seven Kibo outfits and a second dorm set that stays in the shop permanently are also on sale from day one.
On PC, the minimum is a GTX 1060, an Intel Core i5-9400F and 16 GB of RAM, with an RTX 2060 and a Core i7-10700K recommended. The install needs about 120 GB, ideally on an SSD. On Android, the minimum is a Snapdragon 855 or Dimensity 1000+ with 6 GB of RAM. On iOS, an iPhone 12 Pro or later on iOS 15. Both mobile versions need about 55 GB free.
This is the Japanese release, published by Yostar. An English version is further off: Manjuu has scheduled the English open beta for summer 2027, on a US-based server. Full launch details are on the official Japanese site.

item.title: hololive Mahjong Is Out in Japan on Mobile and PC, With Featured Gachas for Four Talents
item.description:
hololive Mahjong -Holojan- is out now in Japan. COVER and Aiming opened the game on November 25, 2026 at 12:00 JST on iOS, Android and Windows. It is free to play with in-game purchases and brings 37 hololive talents to the mahjong table, with cross-play between phones and PC.
One platform missed the date. The browser version, planned for the same day through now.gg, has been delayed so it can run in a more stable environment. The team will announce the new date once it is set.
Talents are obtained through the gacha. The first featured banners of the hololive Mahjong launch raise the rates for Aki Rosenthal, Shirakami Fubuki, Houshou Marine and Ichijou Ririka, and for the accessories tied to each of them. The four are also the singers of the game’s theme song.
The premium currency is Jewels. The official web store gives more bonus free Jewels per purchase than the in-app shop. A talent is more than a card at the table: playing three matches in Ranked Match or Single Mode with an eligible character unlocks scenarios with special illustrations.
The official X account is also running a release giveaway: 25 winners get tournament invitation-style cards and Team Holo Mahjong polo shirts, entered by following the account and reposting.
The talents play the game too, and the matchmaking can seat you with them. When an online match puts you at the same table as a hololive talent, a special animation plays to announce that the real one has shown up, and you receive a Match Certificate to save as proof of the game. Aki Rosenthal was already climbing ranked matches on launch day and streamed the game the same evening.
To go with the launch, the official channel released the animated music video for the theme song, Kami Tsumo☆Dora Dora Densetsu (神ツモ☆ドラドラ伝説), with the four featured talents sending mahjong tiles flying across space:
The official 3D short anime series also got a new episode on YouTube and TikTok the same day.
On PCs with Windows Smart App Control turned on, the Windows version can show a warning during installation or launch, or fail to start at all. The team has confirmed the problem and plans to fix it in a future update. Players who move between phone and PC can carry their progress over with the in-game Account Linking option.

item.title: Mushoku Tensei: Chronicle of Echoes Launches in Taiwan, Hong Kong and Macau With a Free 5-Star Pick
item.description:
Mushoku Tensei: Chronicle of Echoes is out in Taiwan, Hong Kong and Macau as of November 24, 2026. The traditional Chinese version of the Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation RPG is now live on the App Store and Google Play, published in the region by Cayenne Entertainment.
The game first launched in Japan on July 27, 2026, from GREE Entertainment and developer ASOBIMO, after passing 500,000 pre-registrations there, and it is also playable on PC through DMM GAMES in that region. A global English release has not been announced yet, so the Chronicle of Echoes Taiwan launch is the second region to get the game.
Pre-registrations for the traditional Chinese version passed 200,000, which unlocked every milestone. All players can claim the rewards in-game:
The first limited story event, Stranded with Sylphiette, follows Rudeus and Sylphiette through a new adventure written for the game. It runs alongside a pick-up banner for [Summer Lady] Sylphiette, a 5-star version of the character in an original summer outfit. Both end on December 23 at 14:59 (UTC+8).
Chronicle of Echoes is a 3D battle RPG that retells the story of Rudeus Greyrat from the light novel and anime, with characters such as Roxy, Sylphiette and Eris as collectible units.
This is the official trailer for the Taiwan, Hong Kong and Macau version:
Battles play out in rounds and are built around simple controls with a strategic layer, and there is an auto-battle mode for players who would rather let the fights run on their own.
The game is free to play with in-app purchases. Download links and the event schedule are on the official Taiwan, Hong Kong and Macau website and the official Facebook page.

item.title: Arknights: Endfield World o’Shrooms Update Arrives November 25 With a Free Mimino; Version 2.0 Heads to Rhodes Island
item.description:
The World o’Shrooms update and Version 2.0 were announced on November 21 in GRYPHLINE’s latest livestream and in the official press release. The update lands days after the game was nominated for Best Mobile Game at The Game Awards 2026 and for Best iPad Game at the 2026 App Store Awards, on top of winning Best Game of 2026 at the Google Play Awards.
The story picks up right after Wuling’s arc closes, and producer Light Zhong describes it as a lighthearted change of pace. Strange mushrooms have taken over an abandoned dam outside Wuling, where Landbreakers worship a giant mushroom and visitors keep slipping into hallucinations. There, the Endministrator meets Kay, a Rhodes Island Operator who has been travelling alone across Talos-II looking for them, armed with a stack of honey waffles.
In combat, Kay is a Nature Vanguard with a carefree style: she throws weapons that scatter across the battlefield, gathers them back for a heavy hammer slam, and drops Picnic Snacks that heal her teammates.
The new area, the Old Dam, has grown into a fairytale mushroom kingdom. Players fire Kay’s honey waffles at mushrooms to open doors and spin fungal bridges, dodge Loquacious Shrooms that scramble their sense of direction, and face mushroom enemies such as the Bolete Prince, with a mountain-sized mushroom waiting at the heart of the dam. Gareth Coker and Owsey return for the soundtrack.
Later in the World o’Shrooms update, everyone who logs in during the Workers’ Guards: Roll Call event gets the Operator Mimino and her signature weapon, Star of Tomorrow, for free, and event missions hand out extra copies to reach full Potential. Gilberta and Rossi return in successive reruns.
Version 2.0 opens the next chapter in the new year. Exiles have been attacking across the Civilization Band, and their real target is Rhodes Island. The Endministrator heads with Perlica into Gypsosia, the Cretaceous Frontiers, where players can board and explore the Rhodes Island landship itself.
A teaser showed 10 characters joining the journey, including Warfarin as the leader of Rhodes Island and a completely redesigned M3. The chapter’s first update adds four maps at once, Rhodes Island among them, and a Main Mission Early Unlock lets players who have finished Remediation Progress skip ahead to Gypsosia while still earning every beginner-event reward. A management sim with the Golden Branch Tribe and a combat mode called Shattered Protocol are also in development.

item.title: Shinobi NEXUS Release Date Set for November 29 in Japan, With 10 Free Pulls at Launch
item.description:
The Shinobi NEXUS release date is set: Honey Parade Games will launch Shinobi NEXUS -Senran Kagura- in Japan on Sunday, November 29, 2026, on iOS, Android and Windows PC through DMM GAMES. Pre-download opens a day earlier, on November 28, and the exact launch time will be posted on the official Shinobi NEXUS account on X.
The date was announced on November 21 in a press release from Marvelous, the owner of the Senran Kagura series, alongside the first broadcast showing the game running. Shinobi NEXUS is set three years after Shinobi Master Senran Kagura: NEW LINK, with a new cast of shinobi girls designed by series artist Nan Yaegashi. Pre-registration stays open until launch.
Every player who starts the game will receive 1,500 Shinobi Souls, the premium currency, which is enough for 10 pulls, plus the SR card Benihime (Shinobi Transformation). On top of that, once the tutorial is finished, players get a 10-pull that can be redrawn as many times as they want, so they can keep rerolling until they land the card they are after.
The game is free to play with optional purchases. Marvelous describes it as a “Hyper Shinobi Battle”: a command RPG in which players collect shinobi cards and build a team with them, keeping the series’ trademark Shinobi Transformation.
The November 21 special was the first time the game was shown in action. Over its 75 minutes, three of the voice actresses, Kana Hishikawa, Hina Natsume and Mai Kanno, play it live and go through the home screen, the dress-up system, team building and battles. The broadcast also introduces the mysterious group of shinobi that appears in the game’s opening animation.
The archive is the best look so far at how a run in Shinobi NEXUS feels before the servers open, from the first screens to a full fight.
Outside combat, Shinobi NEXUS leans on customization. Characters can be dressed in different outfits, picked from a clothing shop, and the game adds a Shinobi Spa, a sauna where the girls go to relax.
For now, the launch is Japan only. Honey Parade Games has not announced an English or global version.

item.title: Zenless Zone Zero 3.4 Release Date Set for December 2, With Free Robin and the Honkai: Star Rail Crossover
item.description:
The announcement came with the version’s Special Program on November 20. It brings three new S-Rank Agents in total: Sunbringer, the first Enchainer, and the two Star Rail guests, Robin and Kafka. Until now, only their first combat trailers had been shown, with no date, rank or role.
The main story of the Sky Island reaches its climax. After the Bangboo corruption incident and the invasion of High Ambitions Corp., the enemy steps out of the shadows and Roscaelifer fights for its survival. For the first time, the three Sunbringers, Dracaene, Lindverne and Eldreda, fight side by side with the Proxies, and an unexpected character leaves new questions open for the next chapter.
The version teaser shows the three of them together for the first time, under a night sky lit by Eldreda’s lance.
Sunbringer is an S-Rank Genesis Flare Armorer, and she plays as a team of three. Eldreda, Lindverne and Dracaene take turns with a lance, a greatsword and a shield, switching between attack and defence. Her attacks stack Gash on enemies; consuming it triggers Maim and fills Wishfire, which lets Eldreda throw her lance and follow up with a joint Chain Attack. Her two-stage Ultimate detonates every Embermark stack at once for an Emberburst.
She arrives in Signal Search on day one together with her signature W-Engine, Dragonfire Mirage. A new Bangboo, Sleepwalkerboo, summons Bangboo soldiers in combat and boosts her damage when she is in the squad.
Robin plays as an off-field support: her Concerto performance shields the team and raises their DEF and DMG, and re-entering the field extends the effect. Her Ultimate also restores Sharpness for Armorer Agents, which makes her a natural partner for Sunbringer. She gets a new outfit, Cosmic Beat.
Kafka is an S-Rank Electric Agent built around Attribute Anomalies and Disorder damage. In her Hunter’s Overture state she chooses between slashes, which raise direct damage, and shots, which build Anomaly faster; slashing an enemy already affected by an Anomaly triggers a Lightning Surge. Her signature W-Engine is Requiem Araneae.
The Signal Search channels of Sunbringer and Robin open on December 2 and run for the whole version. Kafka arrives in the second half, after January 1, together with the rerun of Alice and the S-Rank Anomaly W-Engine Practiced Perfection.
Robin is also free: logging in after the update gives her along with the materials to reach Lv. 40 and a full set of Drive Discs with suitable main stats. The check-in event adds 2,320 Polychromes, 10 Encrypted Master Tapes, 10 Boopons and a Pom-Pom accessory, and the version also hands out all the remaining Agent Focus: Pyrois and overclock materials for the Twilight Afterimage W-Engine.
The collaboration event, “Lost in a Theatrical Dream”, has the Proxies filming a series with Robin, Kafka and their New Eridu friends, with stealth raids and Agent interactions. Its rewards include Polychromes and a collab Bangboo, Pom-Pom. The version also adds the “Opening Act: Enter the Knight” combat mode and a new “Dark Dungeon Survival” season for Enigma of the Labyrinth.
Outside combat, each Sunbringer gets her own Trust Events, and maxing all three unlocks a side quest to plan their birthday party. Their daily outfit set, Moonlit Promenade, and the Starlit Stroll Limited Gift, with a three-person Accompany Experience, are also coming.
The game’s music is also heading elsewhere: HoYoverse announced a Zenless Zone Zero DLC for DJMAX RESPECT V, expected next year.
Version 3.4 releases on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Cloud Gaming, PC (official launcher and Steam), iOS and Android. More details are on the official website.
